title: Dimension bounded by the scale
statement: Let $k,n,a,d$ be natural numbers with $1\leq k\leq n$, $a>0$, and $2a\leq d$. Define the scale by $\left\lceil nd/a\right\rceil$, the least natural number $m$ such that $ma\geq nd$. Then $n$ is at most this scale.
hypotheses_covered: The bias numerator a is positive
